# At Home With Nikki

> Professional organizing services and educational resources for home and office organization in Charleston, SC and Charlotte, NC, led by organizer Nikki Boyd.

At Home With Nikki offers professional organizing services, digital products, published books on organization and estate planning, and a mentorship course for aspiring professional organizers. The site showcases portfolio projects, organizing tips, and lifestyle coaching resources across multiple service areas.
